title: The AI Conference (SF) — Tim O'Reilly and Eric Ries fireside on building AI companies that matter
summary: The AI Conference 2026 — the 5,500-person San Francisco gathering of AI builders, researchers, and leaders (Sept 29–Oct 1) — announces a fireside chat between Tim O'Reilly (O'Reilly Media founder & CEO) and Eric on founder responsibility and the future of the AI-powered economy.
blockquote: Join Tim O'Reilly, Founder & CEO of O'Reilly Media, and Eric Ries, Founder and Author of The Lean Startup and The Startup Incorruptible, for a fireside chat on what it takes to build AI companies that matter.
attribution_title: 5,500+ AI builders, researchers, and leaders; 120+ speakers; San Francisco, Sept 29–Oct 1, 2026
